texts.li: Shortest night of the year, and {A_nameDef} wants a bonfire: a proper one, taller than the roof, with singing and drinking and the night shift let off until dawn.\n\nIt would burn through a good stack of firewood.
A stack of logs has been growing behind the barn all week, a few at a time, mostly after dark. It's {A_nameDef}'s. Midsummer is tomorrow, and {A_nameDef} would like permission to set fire to it.

li.label: Light the bonfire
li.outcome: The midsummer fire burned until dawn, and most of the colony was still around it when the sun came up.

li.label: Save the wood this year
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} sat on the unlit log pile all evening, looking at it.

li.label: A small fire, no drinking
li.outcome: They had a small fire and went to bed early. {A_nameDef} called it "a candle with ambitions."

texts.li: The last of the crop is in. {A_nameDef}, who planted most of it, wants a harvest supper with second helpings all round, about {COUNT} raw food's worth.\n\nThe stores have to last the winter either way.
"We grew it. We ought to get to taste it." {A_nameDef} has been in the fields since the thaw and wants one night for a harvest home, which would cost about {COUNT} raw food.

li.label: A harvest feast for everyone
li.outcome: The harvest home went on late, and even the cook had seconds.

li.label: Store every scrap for winter
li.outcome: Every grain went into storage. {A_nameDef} stood in the barn doorway a long while that evening, looking at the sacks.

li.label: A modest supper
li.outcome: They had a good meal, nothing extravagant, and the stores hardly felt it.

texts.li: Dark by mid-afternoon, and colder every hour after. It's the longest night of the year, and {A_nameDef} thinks it should be marked the way it was back home, with extra food and a long evening around the fire.
Last night {A_nameDef} went round the rooms and found each colonist in a different one, alone with the cold. "It's midwinter," {A_nameDef} told the council. "We should be in one place for it."

li.label: Extra rations for the long night
li.outcome: The colony ate well on the longest night, and there was singing afterward.

li.label: Stories by the fire, no feast
li.outcome: They spent the evening telling stories around the fire, some sad, some filthy, until the fire burned down.

li.label: Just another night
li.outcome: The longest night passed like any other, cold and dark and quiet.

ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: naming the year

texts.li: It started as a joke at dinner, the idea that the new year needs a name, and now the colony is arguing about it. {A_nameDef} has proposed "the year of {A_nameDef}," loudly and often, and has already started dating things that way.

Chalked on the wall by the door, as of this morning:

The year of {A_nameDef}: one vote, in {A_nameDef}'s handwriting.
The year of our dead: several.
The year of the muffalo: more than anyone expected.

The council has been asked to settle it.

ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.traditionLabel: naming the year after a muffalo

li.label: The year of {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: This is now officially the year of {A_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} has mentioned it a dozen times since breakfast.

li.label: Name it for those we lost
li.outcome: The year is named for the dead. That evening the colony walked out to the graves and said each name once, and the arguing stopped there.

li.label: the names said at the graves
The year of the muffalo
li.outcome: It is the year of the muffalo. The muffalo has not been told. {A_nameDef} is sulking.

texts.li: The raiders' gear is heaped by the gate, and some of it is better than anything the colony owns. {A_nameDef} did most of the shooting and thinks that earns {A_objective} first pick.\n\nSome of the others disagree, out loud.
The bodies are hardly cold and the argument over their boots has already started. {A_nameDef}, who brought down more of them than anyone, has claimed the best of it.

li.label: {A_nameDef} earned first pick
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} took the best of the spoils. A few of the others grumble that they fought too.

li.label: Share everything equally
li.outcome: The spoils went to the common stores, to be shared out equally. Most think that's fair. {A_nameDef} doesn't, and says so.

li.label: The fighters get the spoils
li.outcome: Whoever fought took a share. Whoever stayed inside got a bucket and the yard to scrub.

li.label: Let the quartermaster share it out
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} sorted the spoils by need: coats to whoever was cold, boots to whoever's had worn through. {A_nameDef} got one good thing out of it and has stopped arguing.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {B_nameDef} laid the spoils out on the threshing floor and handed them out one by one, by need. {A_nameDef} got the bow {A_pronoun} wanted and let the rest go without a fuss.
[!lowtech] {B_nameDef} wrote every item down, then shared them out by need. {A_nameDef} got the rifle {A_pronoun} wanted, signed for it, and hasn't put it down since.
[b:trait:Kind] {B_nameDef} gave the warmest coats to the ones who stood watch longest, and the rest by need. Even {A_nameDef} said it was fair.

li.riskOutcome: {B_nameDef} shared the spoils out by need, and {A_nameDef} ended up with a pair of boots two sizes too big. The argument has moved from the council to the quartermaster.

li.reason: Needs a quartermaster on the council

texts.li: The raiders lie where they fell. Graves, a pyre, or the treeline and the scavengers: {A_nameDef} wants the council to choose, and the colony is split three ways on it.
{A_nameDef} has been standing over the bodies outside the wall since the fighting stopped. "They were people," {A_nameDef} says. "Somebody's people. What do we do with them?"

li.label: Give them graves
li.outcome: It took the afternoon and every shovel in the colony, but the raiders are in the ground outside the wall. Some slept better for it. Others want to know why the colony dug graves for people who came to kill it.

li.label: Burn them
li.outcome: The bodies were burned on a pyre that went all night. The smell hung over the colony until morning.

li.label: Drag them to the treeline
li.outcome: The bodies were dragged to the treeline and left there for whatever comes out of the woods.

li.label: the dead taken to the tree line
One grave for all of them
li.outcome: The raiders went into one long trench outside the wall, filled in before dark. {A_nameDef} said a few words over it.

outcomes.li: [winter] The ground was too hard for more than one grave, so the raiders share a shallow trench under the snow outside the wall.
[trait:Kind] One trench for all of them, filled in before dark. {A_nameDef} wanted names on it and settled for a count.

li.label: Into the crematorium
li.outcome: The raiders went into the crematorium one after another, and by evening there was nothing left of them but the smell.

li.label: the raiders taken to the crematorium

texts.li: The attack is over, and people are laughing too loudly at things that aren't funny, the way they do after. {A_nameDef} wants a victory feast tonight, about {COUNT} raw food, while the feeling lasts.\n\nThe repairs would wait until morning.
The fighting stopped an hour ago, and {A_nameDef} is already asking the council for a feast. "We earned it," {A_nameDef} says, wiping someone else's blood off {A_possessive} sleeve.

li.label: A victory feast
li.outcome: They ate and drank until well after dark, loud with relief.

li.label: Repairs first, celebrations later
li.outcome: It was straight back to work on the walls, the wounded and the bodies. The celebration never happened.

li.label: A quick hot meal, then the walls
li.outcome: The colony ate a hot meal standing up, and the repairs started before the bowls were cleared.

outcomes.li: [winter] A pot of something hot went round the yard, and they ate it with their gloves on before going back to the walls.
[colony:Hardworking] A hot meal and back to work, as usual here. {A_nameDef} ate {A_possessive} share slowly, to make it last.

li.label: the hot meal after the battle
Have the best cook stretch half the food
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} made a feast out of half the food anyone expected, mostly stew and nerve, and the colony ate until late.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {B_nameDef} kept three pots going over the fire and fed the colony twice from half the stores. The walls waited until morning.
[b:trait:Gourmand] {B_nameDef} cooked as if for a lord's table and ate as much as anyone, but the food lasted. It was a good night.

li.riskOutcome: {B_nameDef} tried to stretch the food too far, and the feast ran out before the second round. It was still a hot meal.
